description: Sends the user's request to a local partner realtor in the city (or to the Domly team where there is no partner), who will contact the user and pick rental options for free. Only call it after the user explicitly agreed to share their contact (phone, Telegram @username or email) for this purpose. The realtor's own services may be paid; the user agrees terms with the realtor.

city.description: City slug from list_cities or its name.

comment.description: Other wishes: district, pets, parking, term of the lease, etc.

contact.description: How the realtor can reach the user: phone with country code, Telegram @username or email.

listing_id.description: Listing id if the request is about a specific listing.

move_in.description: When the user wants to move in: now, within a month, or later.

rooms.description: Wanted number of rooms; 5 means 5 or more.

user_consented.description: true only if the user explicitly agreed to share this contact with a realtor.

name: request_realtor
title: Request Realtor
